commits.comment: 修复 NormalizeDebugLineLocations 对独立浮点扩展/截断（arith.extf/arith.truncf）的调试行号分类。原实现先判断 isArithmeticOrCastOp（应包含 extf/truncf），并在 isAddressComputationOp 之前介入，导致独立 FP 转换被误标为 synthetic；新实现新增 isFloatingPointExtensionOrTruncationOp，并在 isAddressComputationOp 中提前返回 false，在 classifyOperation 中让该类算子按同一行是否已有 semantic anchor（load/store）决定 semantic 或 synthetic，从而保留真正属于源码语义的独立转换行号。该 pass 属于 ttir_to_linalg 链末端的 normalize_debug_line_locations 阶段，改动影响 Ascend 调试信息还原质量（msdebug），不改变数值语义。风险较低，但分类优先级重排需留意与 isArithmeticOrCastOp 的覆盖重叠。

test_impact.reason: 变更已在 normalize_debug_line_locations.mlir 中新增 floating_point_conversion_classification 用例，覆盖 extf/truncf 在同源行有/无 anchor 的两种分类，属于必须保留的回归断言。

commits.comment: 修正 make_launcher 中 AutoBlockify block cap 的判定逻辑：此前 row_coalescing_applied 会无条件抑制 enable_auto_map_parallel_blocks，导致 RowCoalescing 生效后不再注入 blockNum cap；新逻辑改为 enable_auto_map_parallel_blocks = auto_map 环境开关 && (is_pure_simt || !has_auto_blockify_blacklist_op)，即 pure-SIMT 时忽略 blacklist，非 pure-SIMT 时仍受 blacklist 约束，且不再因 row_coalescing_applied 而关闭 cap。这使 launcher 侧的 cap 注入与 compiler 侧 _finalize_program_launch_policy 的策略保持一致（同日晚些的 972e985 进一步统一到同一表达式）。注意该 commit 与 972e985 对同一段代码做先后修改，本 commit 为过渡态，需连同后续 commit 一起理解。风险中等：launcher 生成的 C++ 源码中 cap 是否存在直接影响 grid 调度，测试断言被同步反向修改（count==0 → ==2）。

commits.comment: 修复 AddMultiBufferOuterScope 中 scf.for 的 polling 条件构建位置：原实现在 waitOp 前插入 condBuilder，导致条件不支配后续各 group 的 scf.if 包装体；改为在 for body 起始处（setInsertionPointToStart）构建，并通过 getFirstBlockId(body) 取 block id（与 CloneOps 连续性假设一致），失败时回退到传入的 bid，与 while 分支行为对齐。这修复了 SSBuffer 动态 CV pipeline 中 for-loop 多缓冲轮询条件的作用域/支配性问题，属于 lowering 正确性修复。风险中等：insertion point 与 block id 来源改变可能影响生成 IR 形态，需靠 DynamicCVPipeline UT 看护。

test_impact.reason: 该修复改变生成 IR 的结构（条件构建位置、block id 来源），需要 DynamicCVPipeline 相关 UT/IR 断言确认新形态且无支配性错误；若既有 ssbuffer 测试仅做端到端数值校验，建议补充 IR 级检查。

commits.comment: 为 TritonToUnstructure 的 offset 分析新增 tt.reshape 支持（parseReshape），处理 pointer 类型 reshape：仅当源具备 common scalar base 且非 allow_reorder+efficient_layout 场景才走 offset 重建路径，否则回退 recordOpaqueTensorPointer；对 allow_reorder 场景移除属性并统一 lane 映射以保证 offset 与剩余 pointer 用户共享同一映射；同时 setUnstructured(rank) 并显式 setScalarLike(false)，避免误导下游 scalar 路径。此外在 parse(BlockArgument) 分支对 RankedTensorType 补充 setUnstructured，保证 block argument 初始状态正确。新增 pointer_reshape.mlir 覆盖 masked load/store、嵌套 addptr、broadcast、uniform、lane-wise base 等场景。实现细致，风险中等——reshape 语义（尤其 allow_reorder）与 offset 结构的关系容易出错，需严格依赖新增 lit 用例。

commits.comment: 更新 do_bench_npu：新增 _raise_on_mismatch 开关，仅在显式要求（target_kernel_name 且使用 npu 方法做 autotune）时抛出 ProfilerResultMismatchError，否则打印错误并返回 inf；无 profiling 数据或空 DataFrame 时返回 0 并告警；do_bench_npu 的 fallback 判定改为 force_fallback = prof_dir or keep_res or (target_kernel_name is not None and not use_autotune)，并使 mspti 路径在非 fallback 时优先尝试。这改变了 benchmark 的结果语义（0 vs inf vs 抛异常），对依赖 do_bench_npu 数值的测试与自动调优流程影响较大：0 耗时可能被误当作有效性能、inf 返回可被上层识别为失败。风险中等，尤其是 0 返回值的语义模糊。

commits.message:
fix(t2l): preserve mixed if results and loop mask semantics (#2040)

Keep non-pointer scf.if results in their original SSA types while
converting marked scalar-pointer results to integer address carriers.
Annotate directly consumed carrier casts as GM before dropping their
pass-local provenance marker.

Preserve evolving loop masks instead of treating their initial values as
invariants. Check the actual forwarding edges, including scf.while slot
mappings, before following a loop mask to its initial value.

Canonicalize supported one-dimensional prefix intersections to a scalar
minimum bound so shrinking and growing thresholds retain the full mask
history while keeping contiguous subview/copy lowering. Preserve users
before and after the update, final results, and zero-trip behavior.

Route other runtime loop masks through supported masked indirect lowering,
guard singleton loads and stores with scf.if, and diagnose unsupported
configurations instead of issuing unguarded loads followed by a select.

Add MLIR and NPU regressions for mixed if results and loop masks, and
update the search-kernel check to require conditional memory access. Gate
the multi-element runtime-mask tests on the A5 masked-indirect capability,
and check the unsupported A3 template mode explicitly.

Validation on Ascend950PR:
- All Ascend MLIR tests: 189 passed.
- Original S17: 2 passed; loop-mask regressions: 32 passed;
  mixed-if regressions: 2 passed, with exact numerical comparisons.
- NPU runs include the existing SSBUFFER dynamic-CV-pipeline fallback.
- All applicable pre-commit hooks passed individually.

commits.comment: 统一并修复 AutoBlockify / RowCoalescing / StoreCoalescing 的策略与失败语义：compiler 侧纯 SIMT 下 auto_blockify_enabled 不再受 has_auto_blockify_blacklist_op 影响（仅受 row_coalescing_applied 影响），ttir_to_npubin 的 --enable-auto-blockify-loop 注入同样去掉 blacklist 门槛；driver.make_launcher 与之对齐；TritonToGraph 引入 RewritePlanApplyResult（Applied/NotApplicable/Failed）区分'不适用'与'失败'，RowCoalescingRule 在 sandbox 校验不通过时返回 NotApplicable 而非 failure，避免把可容忍的 late 不匹配升级为 pass error；RowCoalescing.cpp 改用 seed.entryGuard 作为插入点/有效性判据，替代 seed.pid->getBlock() 与 validCount 定位，使 hoist 到 pid 之前的 bound 也能正确插入；StoreCoalescingRule 新增 enabledForCompileMode 选项，在 SimtOnly 模式下既不要求 alias 分析也不产出候选。整体是策略一致性与失败模式治理，质量提升明显，但涉及 compiler/driver/三处 launcher 断言与 graph rule 语义，风险中等偏高。

test_impact.reason: 大量测试被同步重写：test_launcher_export_api.py 参数矩阵新增 is_pure_simt/row_coalescing_applied 维度，test_compiler_layout_memory_contract.py 新增 _finalize_program_launch_policy 纯 SIMT 用例与 linalg_to_npubin auto-blockify 用例，test_row_coalescing_compat.py 新增 bound-before-pid 与 late-sandbox-decline 用例，test_layout_memory_895_closure_differential.py 大规模改用 rebase base 并对 cap 期望做反向断言。这些断言反映新契约，必须持续看护，且其中差异测试依赖 git 历史 commit（_REBASE_BASE_COMMIT），需注意仓库历史可获取性。

commits.message:
[CI](fix) stop stale bot starvation by sweeping oldest-first without op limit (#2196)

The stale workflow was configured with operations-per-run: 30 and the
default newest-first order. Each daily run only reached the ~newest 250
of 421 open items before exhausting its operation budget ("No more
operations left! Exiting..."), so old stale items were never evaluated
for closing. The repo accumulated 125+ open stale items while only the
newest ones ever got closed.

Changes:
- ascending: true, so the oldest items are processed first
- operations-per-run: 1000, effectively unlimited (a full sweep of the
  repo costs ~350 operations; the GITHUB_TOKEN rate limit is 5000
  requests/hour)
- fix stale-issue-message: close window is 7 days (days-before-issue-close
  was changed from 14 to 7), the message still said 14

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
